name: Kindred
description: A thoughtful support workspace with local reply drafts, conversation ownership and a complete searchable help center.
tagline: Good help feels like being heard.

notes.layout: Editorial serif proposition, layered native inbox preview, conversational product narrative and a complete support workspace
notes.motion: Restrained interface transitions, contextual article insertion and responsive queue changes
notes.interaction: Edit per-ticket drafts and notes, assign owners and status, insert relevant help articles, search documentation and export drafts
notes.provenance: Nine independently composed pages with original fictional conversations, complete help articles, local ticket workflows and original visual assets.
